body.p: This Professional Services Agreement (this "Agreement") is entered into as of {{effective}} (the "Effective Date") between {{fontara_entity}} (the "Client"), and **{{firm}}**, {{firm_entity}} with its principal place of business at {{firm_address}}, {{firm_city}}, {{firm_region}} {{firm_postal}} (the "Firm").
The Firm will provide {{services}} under one or more SOWs. For budgeting, the blended rate is {{currency}}{{rate}} per hour; time is billed at the rate card below.

The Firm shall perform the services described in each statement of work the parties sign under this Agreement (an "SOW"). This Agreement sets the terms that govern every SOW; each SOW is separately enforceable, and services outside an SOW's scope require a new or amended SOW signed before the work begins.

This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues until either party ends it. Either party may terminate this Agreement or any SOW for convenience on 30 days' written notice, or for the other's material breach not cured within 30 days after notice. On termination the Client pays for services performed and approved expenses incurred through the termination date, and the Firm delivers all work in progress.

The Firm shall name its key personnel in each SOW. It may replace a key person on 30 days' written notice with personnel of equal or greater seniority and qualifications, and shall tell the Client promptly of any unexpected staffing change.

The Firm shall perform the services in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards for similar engagements, using personnel qualified for the work. For 30 days after the Client accepts a deliverable, the Firm shall correct at no charge any failure of the deliverable to meet its SOW.

then.p: The Firm retains its pre-existing intellectual property and general methodologies. Custom deliverables that an SOW identifies as "work made for hire" are owned by the Client on payment in full, and the Firm grants the Client a perpetual, royalty-free license to any Firm background material incorporated in them. The Firm may continue to use general know-how and non-proprietary methods learned in the engagement.

The Client owns all custom deliverables, including any improvements to the Firm's methods developed for this engagement. The Firm licenses to the Client, royalty-free and for all purposes, any background material incorporated in the deliverables, and may not use the Client's deliverables as templates for other clients without the Client's written consent.

All deliverables are licensed to the Client, not assigned. The Firm owns all tools, frameworks and accelerators, whether or not developed or refined during the engagement, and may reuse the deliverables, anonymized, as templates for other clients.

body.p: Each party shall keep the other's confidential information confidential and use it only for the engagement. The Firm may not disclose the Client's identity or the details of the engagement without the Client's consent, and the Client may not disclose the Firm's proprietary methods or tools. These obligations continue for 3 years after the engagement ends.

For 12 months after the last SOW ends, neither party shall solicit for employment the other's personnel directly involved in the engagement; general advertising and recruiting are not restricted. A party that hires such a person in breach of this section shall pay the other, as liquidated damages, three months of that person's annualized salary.

The Firm shall defend and indemnify the Client against third-party claims arising from the Firm's gross negligence or willful misconduct, from a deliverable's infringement of a third party's intellectual property, or from any claim by the Firm's personnel for wages, benefits or employment status. The Client shall defend and indemnify the Firm against third-party claims arising from the Client's gross negligence or willful misconduct. The indemnified party shall give prompt notice of the claim, control of its defense and reasonable cooperation.

then.p: Each party's liability is capped at the fees paid in the prior 12 months under the SOW giving rise to the claim, and neither party is liable for consequential, indirect or special damages. The cap and exclusion do not apply to breach of confidentiality, indemnification obligations or willful misconduct.

The Firm's liability is capped at the total fees paid or committed under this Agreement. The cap does not apply to breach of confidentiality, disputes over ownership of intellectual property or claims arising from professional negligence, and the Firm is liable for direct economic loss caused by its professional errors.

The Firm's liability is capped at the fees paid for the specific engagement, and neither party is liable for consequential damages, including lost profits, lost data, lost business opportunity or reputational harm. No claim is excluded from the cap.

body.p: The Firm invoices monthly in arrears for time worked at the rates in the rate card, with its expenses, and the Client pays undisputed amounts {{payment_terms}} after receiving a correct invoice.

body.p: The Client reimburses reasonable expenses at actual cost against receipts. Travel follows the Client's travel and expense policy or the Firm's standard policy, whichever is lower; any single expense over {{currency}}500 needs the Client's prior approval; and the Firm submits itemized expense reports monthly.

The Firm shall maintain professional liability (professional indemnity) insurance of at least {{currency}}2,000,000 per claim, general (public) liability insurance of at least {{currency}}1,000,000 per occurrence, and the employers' liability or workers' compensation insurance the law requires, and shall provide a certificate of insurance before work begins.
Certificate of insurance: [[attach:Firm:Certificate of insurance]]

Where the Firm processes personal data on the Client's behalf, it does so only on the Client's documented instructions and under a data processing agreement the parties sign before the processing begins.

The parties are independent contractors. Nothing in this Agreement creates a partnership, joint venture, agency, fiduciary or employment relationship between them, and neither party may make any commitment binding the other.

Notices under this Agreement must be in writing and delivered by hand, by recognized overnight courier or by email to the addresses stated in this Agreement or later notified in writing. A notice is effective on confirmed delivery or, for email, when the recipient acknowledges it. Notices of breach, termination or a legal claim must be sent by courier, with a copy by email.

Neither party may assign or transfer this Agreement without the other party's prior written consent, which may not be unreasonably withheld, except that either party may assign it on written notice to an affiliate, or to a successor to all or substantially all of the business or assets to which it relates that assumes it in writing. Any other attempted assignment is void. This Agreement binds and benefits the parties and their permitted successors and assigns.

Neither party is liable for a delay or failure to perform, other than an obligation to pay money, caused by events beyond its reasonable control, including natural disasters, epidemics, war, terrorism, civil unrest, government action and widespread failures of the internet or public utilities. The affected party shall notify the other within 5 business days and use reasonable efforts to resume performance. If the event continues for more than 60 days, either party may terminate the affected performance under this Agreement on written notice without liability.

then.p: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules. The parties shall first try to resolve any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement by good-faith negotiation between senior executives for 30 days. A dispute not resolved in that time shall be finally settled by binding arbitration administered by the American Arbitration Association under its Commercial Arbitration Rules, before a single arbitrator, seated in San Francisco, California, and judgment on the award may be entered in any court of competent jurisdiction. Either party may seek injunctive relief from a court to protect its confidential information or intellectual property.

This Agreement, and any non-contractual obligation arising out of or in connection with it, is governed by the law of England and Wales. The parties shall first try to resolve any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement by good-faith negotiation between senior executives for 30 days. A dispute not resolved in that time shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration under the LCIA Rules, which are incorporated by reference into this section, before a sole arbitrator, with the seat of arbitration in London and English as the language of the arbitration. Either party may seek urgent injunctive relief from a court.

This Agreement, and any non-contractual obligation arising out of or in connection with it, is governed by the laws of Ireland. The parties shall first try to resolve any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement by good-faith negotiation between senior executives for 30 days, after which the courts of Ireland have exclusive jurisdiction to settle it.

body.p: This Agreement is the entire agreement of the parties on its subject and supersedes all prior proposals, negotiations, representations and understandings about it. Each party confirms that in entering into it, it has not relied on any statement not set out in it. This Agreement may be amended only in a writing signed by authorized representatives of both parties.

Any provision of this Agreement that by its nature is intended to survive its termination or expiration survives it, including the Intellectual Property, Confidentiality, Non-Solicitation, Indemnification and Liability sections, together with any payment obligation accrued before termination.

If any provision of this Agreement is held invalid or unenforceable, it is enforced to the maximum extent permitted and the rest of this Agreement continues in full force. No failure or delay in exercising a right is a waiver of it, and a waiver is effective only if it is in writing and signed. No person other than the parties and their permitted successors and assigns has any right to enforce any term of this Agreement. This Agreement may be signed in counterparts and by electronic signature, each of which is an original and all of which together are one instrument.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have signed this Agreement by their authorized representatives as of the Effective Date.
